implementation_constraints: Implement only SLICE-P03 Invitation, SetupToken, and PasswordResetToken persistence in the Identity module.
Do not introduce Credential, Membership, Organization, tenant, authorization, audit, or other slice tables.
Invitation requires authoritative owner IdentityId; optional invited IdentityId remains distinct and may be null.
SetupToken and PasswordResetToken require authoritative IdentityId ownership.
Persist only cryptographic verifier/hash material for Invitation acceptance secrets and single-use tokens; never persist raw reusable secrets.
Enforce Invitation 7-day, SetupToken 15-minute, and PasswordResetToken 1-hour expiry semantics.
Single-use consumption and revocation must be atomic; terminal states cannot be reused.
Protected P03 reads/writes require authoritative IdentityId.
Do not copy organization/location/role/capability authority into P03 persistence.
Do not encode C15 deletion, anonymization, general retention, or legal-exemption semantics while OQ-PRIV-1/2/3 remain open.
Every schema change ships with the next immutable ordered Drizzle migration; do not edit existing migrations.
Do not execute shared or production migrations.
